description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers and Mana Echoes triggers twice.
Resolve the Marneus Calgar trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve both Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C}{C} for each Astartes Warrior you control.
Repeat.
